title: Machine-Verified Two-Sided Bounds for Simple Multi-Item Auctions: 2.1946 <= c* <= 2.486 and an i.i.d. Lower Bound above 1.316
source_inventory_policy: Normal scope covers the setting definitions and all five named results (Theorems 1, 2, 4, Corollary 3, Proposition 5) in Section 1 of the pinned Zenodo v1.0.1 LaTeX source. Canonical v11 review binds one transparent PaperInterface Spec to each selected source claim; retained source claims without a current Spec route remain explicit audit work rather than disappearing from the inventory.
declared_scope_exclusions: Literature review, numerical limits exploration (Section 5 non-rigorous floats), stylised financial auction illustration, table captions, and narrative prose are outside normal named-theory coverage.

general_lower_bound.statement: There exist m and independent finitely supported distributions D_1, ..., D_m on R_{>=0} such that REV(D) > 2.1946 * max(SREV(D), BREV(D)), witnessed by a deterministic mechanism.

source_anchor_evidence.quoted_text:
\begin{theorem}[General Lower Bound; Lean: \texttt{SimpleAuctions.lower\_bound}]\label{thm:lb}
There exist $m \in \mathbb{N}$ and independent finitely supported distributions $D_1, \dots, D_m$ on $\R_{\ge 0}$ such that
\[
  \REV(D) > 2.1946 \max\{\SREV(D), \BREV(D)\}.
\]
The witnessing mechanism is deterministic.
\end{theorem}

universal_upper_bound.statement: For every finite index set and family of independent finitely supported distributions D, REV(D) <= 1.1187 * SREV(D) + 1.367299 * BREV(D), and in particular for every m and D : Fin m -> FinDist, REV(D) <= 2.486 * max(SREV(D), BREV(D)).

source_anchor_evidence.quoted_text:
\begin{theorem}[Universal Upper Bound; Lean: \texttt{SimpleAuctions.upper\_bound\_two}, \texttt{upper\_bound}]\label{thm:ub}
For every finite index set $\iota$ and every family of independent finitely supported distributions $D : \iota \to \mathrm{FinDist}$,
\[
  \REV(D) \le 1.1187\,\SREV(D) + 1.367299\,\BREV(D).
\]
In particular, for every $m \in \mathbb{N}$ and every $D : \mathrm{Fin}\,m \to \mathrm{FinDist}$,
\[
  \REV(D) \le 2.486 \max\{\SREV(D), \BREV(D)\}.
\]
\end{theorem}

iid_lower_bound.statement: There exist m (specifically m = 40) and a finitely supported distribution F on R_{>=0} such that REV(F^{otimes m}) > 1.316 * max(SREV(F^{otimes m}), BREV(F^{otimes m})), witnessed by a deterministic two-part tariff with entry fee 9 and item price 4.

source_anchor_evidence.quoted_text:
\begin{theorem}[i.i.d.\ Lower Bound; Lean: \texttt{SimpleAuctions.iid\_lower\_bound}]\label{thm:iid}
There exist $m \in \mathbb{N}$ and a finitely supported distribution $F$ on $\R_{\ge 0}$ (specifically $m = 40$) such that
\[
  \REV(F^{\otimes m}) > 1.316 \max\{\SREV(F^{\otimes m}), \BREV(F^{\otimes m})\}.
\]
The witnessing mechanism is a deterministic two-part tariff (entry fee $9$, item price $4$).
\end{theorem}
